title: Data & AI Product Owner
description:
Data & AI Product Owner
London (Hybrid, 3 days per week) | Up to £80,000

A leading global professional services organisation is investing heavily in Data, AI, and digital transformation, creating an exciting opportunity for a Data & AI Product Owner to join a growing team. This is a chance to take ownership of innovative data and AI products from concept through to delivery, working with senior stakeholders and technical specialists on solutions that drive meaningful business impact.

The Company

Our client is a highly respected international organisation operating within a complex, data-rich environment. They are building a dedicated Data & AI product function to support the development of advanced analytics, machine learning, and generative AI solutions across the business.
With significant investment in technology and a strong focus on innovation, they are creating products that improve decision-making, automate processes, and unlock value from enterprise data. This role offers the opportunity to help shape both the product roadmap and the future direction of the Data & AI capability.

The Role


Key responsibilities include:

  • Partnering with stakeholders across the business to identify opportunities for Data & AI products
  • Gathering and refining requirements, use cases, and business priorities
  • Defining product vision, roadmap priorities, and delivery plans
  • Managing and prioritising product backlogs to maximise business value
  • Balancing competing stakeholder demands and driving decision-making
  • Working closely with Data Scientists, Machine Learning Engineers, and technology teams throughout development
  • Overseeing delivery from MVP through to production deployment and adoption
  • Contributing to the wider Data & AI product strategy and roadmap
  • Products may include AI-enabled workflow solutions, data-driven decision support tools, generative AI applications, knowledge retrieval platforms, and commercial intelligence products.

Your Skills & Experience

  • Experience as a Product Owner or Product Manager delivering products end-to-end
  • Strong commercial experience working with data products, analytics platforms, or AI solutions
  • Proven ability to manage stakeholders across technical and non-technical teams
  • Experience owning and prioritising product backlogs
  • Strong discovery, requirements gathering, and product strategy capabilities
  • Experience working closely with Data Scientists, Engineers, or Analytics teams
  • Understanding of modern data platforms and AI product environments
  • Exposure to Databricks, Generative AI, or machine learning products would be advantageous
  • Experience within professional services, consulting, financial services, legal, or other regulated environments is highly desirable

What They Offer

  • Up to £80,000 base salary
  • Comprehensive benefits package
  • Hybrid working model based in London
  • Opportunity to help shape a newly established Data & AI Product function
  • Genuine ownership of product roadmap, prioritisation, and strategy
  • Exposure to innovative AI and data initiatives with senior stakeholder visibility
  • Clear opportunity for progression within a growing Data & AI team

How to Apply

If you're a Product Owner or Product Manager with experience delivering data or AI products and are looking for an opportunity to influence strategy while working on cutting-edge initiatives, apply today to learn more.
